name: Two Sum
source: LeetCode 1, ported. The statement gives no input format and no bounds; both were chosen here, and every domain is marked accordingly.

variables.name: n
variables.source: CHOSEN. The statement never says how many numbers there are, but an array read from stdin needs its length read first. At least 2 so a pair can exist. 2*10^5 admits the O(n) hash map solution and excludes the O(n^2) scan, which would be 4*10^10 operations.

variables.name: t
variables.source: CHOSEN. A pair of the extreme element values sums to at most 2*10^9, so a target outside this range is unreachable and the problem would be trivial.

variables.name: a
variables.source: CHOSEN. The usual bound on this problem, and it keeps every pair sum inside a 64 bit integer.
